name: Juliana
declaringWar: It's getting harder and harder to put up with you. I'll have to destroy you for the good of the Republic!
attacked: This will not be the end. We will resist!
denounced: You're confusing my respect with fear!
defeated: You defeated me, but you will be haunted by the tears of your victims!
introduction: Good morning, I am David Canabarro, General and leader of the Juliana Republic. We seek stability with our neighbors.
tradeRequest: It will certainly be mutually beneficial to both us.

name: Palmares
declaringWar: I couldn't help but notice your audacity in turning against us. Quilombolas we will destroy the enemy!
attacked: These lands will never be yours. You will achieve nothing with this aggression!
denounced: I'm interested in what you're going to do after that.
defeated: Your resentment echoes in the destroyed ruins of the mocambos. You may have won this war in name, but I won it in spirit!
introduction: Welcome to the Quilombo dos Palmares, where enslaved people and deserters find refuge amidst the chaos. Tell me about yourself.
tradeRequest: I've been wondering if this is possible between our peoples.
